ValidationRule.description: CJ: Created for NZC Implementation. Purpose: Restrict to create record for ESG and Data Modeller user when record is not system generated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c, "ESG Team"), ISPICKVAL($User.User_Type__c, "Data Modeller") ), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(IsSystemGeneratedRecord))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to create energy use record manually, Please contact NZC administrator for more information.
